title: MissingInfoSiteBoundary
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch, Phase 2 — the site-boundary missing-information rule. Output is a plain string|null, not the {text,category,discipline} object shape used by runStage1Risks() rules. Contract version 1.0.0.

input.description: The raw p.facts.siteBoundaryStatus value. Inequality against 'confirmed'.

output.description: The fixed missing-info text, or null when siteBoundaryStatus === 'confirmed'.

oneOf.const: Site boundary not yet confirmed on a site map.
